headline: GRAVEL YARD opens — dig, shake, haul, shout
lede: A golden-hour co-op sandbox where nobody sees the whole job: the digger knows where the gravel is wet, the screen plant knows which gate pours which grade, and the truck owns the order board. The chain pays only when the crew talks.

notes.text: GRAVEL YARD shipped (#1253, PR #1303): 180-second shifts, a three-machine chain (digger -> shaker screen -> graded bays -> truck), wet-seam jams you jog with B, wrong-grade refusals that strike, and a radio channel that says what the other seats see.

1-3 hands, any seat any brain: unfilled seats run CPU crew members that press the same keys you do — the full CPU crew makes the 600C quota on 8/8 seeds, and still 7/8 with one unit less on every pile cell.

New gates: gravelcheck (53 assertions incl. browser contract determinism) and gravelplay (20 real-key gates: dig and dump with real keystrokes, drawn pixels checked against the sim). A mutant that drops a refusal strike turns both red as designed.
SHORT ORDER SHOUT stage 2 (online kitchen lobby) is queued as #1291 — the same lockstep seat plumbing GRAVEL YARD is built on.
